edges.note: Section 9010 asserts federal eminent domain over recovered technologies 'controlled by private persons or entities.' Reasoning: the legislative remedy matches the mechanism AARO records interviewees describing; no drafting record ties the two documents.

edges.note: The Senate passed Division I of the NDAA on 27 July 2023 including Sec. 9010, and defined 'legacy program' to include 'commercial industry... and private sector endeavors to collect, exploit, or reverse engineer technologies of unknown origin.'
